info.name: EZ Key Public auth
info.description:
Unauthenticated Auth API endpoints for mobile clients, operators, and QA.

## Endpoints

- **Get public instance info**: Read-only metadata (`instanceName`, `instanceDescription`, `aboutUrl`, `authApiPublicBaseUrl`) — **same JSON contract** as `EZ Key Public admin` (`GET /api/v1/public/instance-info` on the Admin API).

## Authentication

**No Bearer token.** No cryptographic signature. These routes are `permitAll` in Spring Security.

## Configuration

Properties are read from the **Auth API** process: `ezkey.qr.auth-base-url` and `ezkey.organization.*` (e.g. `EZKEY_QR_AUTH_BASE_URL`, `EZKEY_ORGANIZATION_ABOUT_URL` in Docker). Set them consistently with the Admin API when both are exposed.

## Environment

Use `{{base_url}}` — same variable as **EZ Key Enrollments auth** and **EZ Key Auth Attempts auth** (`http://localhost:8080` in `postman/environments/local.postman_environment.json`).

request.description:
Returns read-only instance metadata for branding and mobile visibility.

**No authentication required.** Same payload as Admin API `GET /api/v1/public/instance-info`.

**Response (200 OK):**
- `instanceName` (string): from `ezkey.organization.name`
- `instanceDescription` (string): from `ezkey.organization.description`
- `aboutUrl` (string | null): from `ezkey.organization.about-url` when set
- `authApiPublicBaseUrl` (string | null): from `ezkey.qr.auth-base-url`; same value as `authUrl` in enrollment QR JSON when configured

**Status codes:**
- 200: OK
- 500: Internal server error
